description: Defines an interface for throttling configuration with methods to get interval and limit, render config, and create instances from config; includes nested enum for config keys and defaults.

classes.name: ThrottlingConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for throttling, including methods to retrieve interval and limit, render config, and instantiate from config. Contains nested enum for config keys and defaults.

classes.name: ThrottlingConfig.ConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining configuration key paths and default values for throttling settings, implementing KnownConfigValue.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration of the throttling interval.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit of messages processed per interval.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Creates a Config object representing the current throttling configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ThrottlingConfig instance from a given Config object.
